python3 -c "
import parse

# Test that using the same name with different types raises RepeatedNameError
try:
    p = parse.Parser('{name:w} {name:l}')
    print('ERROR: Should have raised RepeatedNameError')
except parse.RepeatedNameError as e:
    print('Correctly raised RepeatedNameError:', str(e))

# Using the same name with the same type should work
p2 = parse.Parser('{name:l} {name:l}')
r2 = p2.parse('hello world')
print('Same type repeated works:', r2.named['name'])
" 2>&1 | tail -5
